gapdown_buy_1.name: Gap down 1%: buy
gapdown_buy_1.desc: The stock opens 1% or more below yesterday's close. Buy at 9:20 AM, betting the fall was too much and the price climbs back during the day.

gapdown_buy_1@mkt.desc: The stock opens 1% or more below yesterday's close. Buy at 9:20 AM, betting the fall was too much and the price climbs back during the day. Only when the Nifty 50 is above its opening price at that moment (below it, for short-sells).
